title: File is 1140 lines (exceeds 1000-line maintainability guideline)
detail: At 1140 lines this file exceeds the maintainability threshold. All Nova hacking checks are consolidated here; splitting by check category (import style, string formatting, logging, cross-driver, etc.) would make each section easier to review and extend. Fix: split into focused sub-modules under `nova/hacking/`.

title: 4× inconsistent return statements (R1710) — functions at lines 252, 272, 675, 1123
detail: Four flake8 checker functions (at/near lines 252, 272, 675, 1123) have code paths that yield or return a value and paths that fall off the end implicitly. For pycodestyle-style check functions this is typically intentional (return nothing to indicate pass), but it can confuse callers and static analysis. Fix: add an explicit `return None` on the implicit paths, or restructure using `yield` consistently throughout each check function.
